steps.en: Install the library with the extras and system tools your file types need
steps.zh: 按文件类型装上可选依赖和系统工具

steps.en: Detects the file type and routes it to the matching partitioner
steps.zh: 识别文件类型，交给对应的分区函数

steps.en: For PDFs and images, reads the text layer or runs a layout model plus OCR, per strategy
steps.zh: PDF 和图片按策略读文字层，或跑版面模型加 OCR

steps.en: Returns typed elements (Title, NarrativeText, Table…) with page and source metadata
steps.zh: 返回带页码和来源元数据的分类型元素（标题、正文、表格……）

steps.en: Chunk the elements along section boundaries for your index
steps.zh: 沿章节边界把元素分块，送进索引

value.en: Every file type becomes the same structured element list, so chunks follow sections instead of cutting tables in half
value.zh: 所有文件类型都变成同一种结构化元素列表，分块顺着章节走，不再把表格拦腰切断
